slides.title: Does Bitcoin crash on Fed day?
slides.sub: We tested 22 US rate decisions since Jan 2024 against Bitcoin's 2-day move.

slides.title: Up or down? A coin flip
paras: We took Bitcoin's close the day before each Fed decision and the close the day after.
Out of 22 decisions: <g>11 up</g>, <r>11 down</r>. <u>The median move was 0.0%.</u>

visual.title: BTC 2 days around a Fed decision

slides.source: Hotcoin calc.: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes (UTC); Fed meeting calendar, Jan 2024 – Sep 2026

slides.title: Only a bit bumpier
paras: On Fed days Bitcoin moved <u>2.7% on average</u> (up or down) over two days.
On any two days in the same period: 2.5%. <g>Fed days are only slightly bigger.</g>
slides.source: Hotcoin calc.: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes, Jan 2024 – Oct 2026

slides.title: 2026 leans red
paras: This year is different: <r>4 of 6</r> Fed decisions came with a drop, three of them of 4% or more.
slides.source: Hotcoin calc.: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes

slides.title: The biggest moves
paras: The largest swing came on <r>Dec 18, 2024</r>: −8.1% in two days.
<u>Big moves went both ways</u>, so the date alone tells you little.
slides.source: Hotcoin calc.: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes

slides.title: This week
paras: The next decision lands on Thursday morning in Asia.
<u>Direction has been a coin flip.</u> If you trade around it, keep positions small.
